product_details.care_1_title: Keep away from heat and direct sunlight
product_details.care_1_text: Place your flowers in a cool spot away from windows, heating vents, or appliances. Direct sunlight and heat will cause petals to wilt and dry out faster.
product_details.care_2_text: Lightly spray a fine mist of water on the petals and leaves every 1–2 days. This keeps the blooms hydrated and adds humidity, especially in air-conditioned rooms.
product_details.care_3_title: Fill up and change water daily
product_details.care_3_text: Refresh the vase water every day to prevent bacterial buildup that blocks stems. Top it up to ensure stems are always submerged at least 5–7 cm deep.
product_details.care_4_title: Ensure floral foam is never completely dry
product_details.care_4_text: If your arrangement uses floral foam, keep it moist at all times by adding water regularly. Dry foam cannot reabsorb water and will cause stems to dehydrate quickly.
product_details.care_5_text: Promptly trim away any dead or drooping flowers and yellow leaves using clean scissors. Wilted parts drain energy and nutrients from healthy blooms, shortening the arrangement's life.
product_details.care_6_title: Discard water and wash vase every second day
product_details.care_6_text: Every other day, empty the vase completely and clean it with mild soap to remove bacteria and residue. A clean vase keeps the water fresher for longer and extends bloom life.
